title: Complete and submit the scholarship application
description: A user can review the multi-step application, submit it to the institute, and receive a submission reference.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the application form
Continue through the application steps
Submit the application to the institute
Verify a submission reference is displayed
Verify the application is shown as submitted

title: Review scholarship dashboard and DBT progress
description: A user can open the portal home page and review the candidate scholarship summary, sanctioned grant, and DBT tranche progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the candidate scholarship dashboard is displayed
Verify sanctioned grant and DBT progress information are displayed

title: Authorize document access and see verified documents
description: This test verifies that a user can complete DigiLocker verification and receive linked documents with verified status indicators.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the DigiLocker services section
Fill in the security verification OTP with a valid six-digit code
Authorize document access
Verify verified documents are displayed
Verify green status badges are visible for fetched documents

title: Open the DigiLocker verification flow and review consent details
description: This test verifies that a user can access DigiLocker verification from the home portal and review the consent notice before entering credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the DigiLocker services section
Verify the institutional email and consent notice are visible
Verify the document verification input is available

title: Review eligible and ineligible schemes
description: A user can open scheme eligibility evaluation and compare which schemes can and cannot be applied for with their rule explanations.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the schemes and eligibility section
Verify eligible and ineligible scheme cards are displayed
Verify eligibility rule explanations are displayed

title: Launch a prefilled application from an eligible scheme
description: A user can choose an eligible scheme and continue into a prefilled scholarship application setup.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the schemes and eligibility section
Choose an eligible scheme to continue
Verify the application form opens with prefilled candidate details
Verify the selected scheme is carried into the application

title: Open the Ask Eklavya assistant and send a scholarship question
description: This test verifies that a user can open the chat modal, submit a scholarship question, and receive a structured response.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Ask Eklavya assistant
Fill in the chat input with a scholarship eligibility question
Send the chat message
Verify a structured assistant response is visible
Verify the conversation modal remains open

title: Open Ask Eklavya and receive a structured response
description: A user can open the chat assistant, send a scholarship question, and receive a structured response in the modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Ask Eklavya chat assistant
Ask a question about scholarship eligibility or DBT status
Verify a structured assistant response is displayed
Verify the chat modal remains open

title: Jump from the dashboard to scheme eligibility
description: A user can use the dashboard navigation to move into the schemes section from the home page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the quick navigation link to the schemes section
Verify the schemes and eligibility section is displayed

title: Jump from the dashboard to DigiLocker verification
description: A user can use the dashboard navigation to move into the DigiLocker verification section from the home page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the quick navigation link to the DigiLocker section
Verify the DigiLocker verification section is displayed

title: Get guidance about DBT status in the assistant
description: This test verifies that the assistant returns scholarship-status guidance when asked about DBT progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Ask Eklavya assistant
Fill in the chat input with a DBT status question
Send the chat message
Verify a response with guidance bullets is visible
Verify scholarship status guidance is shown

title: Update the target scheme during application setup
description: A user can change the selected scholarship scheme in the application form and continue with the updated scheme.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the application form
Change the target scholarship scheme
Continue through the application steps
Verify the updated scheme remains selected in the application
Verify the application progress continues normally

title: Change the portal language and see the interface update
description: This test verifies that a multilingual user can switch the portal language and see the interface update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the language selector
Select a supported non-default language
Verify the interface language updates
Verify the portal content remains visible in the selected language

title: Close the assistant after reading a response
description: This test verifies that a user can dismiss the chat modal after viewing guidance and return to the portal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Ask Eklavya assistant
Fill in the chat input with a scholarship question
Send the chat message
Close the conversation modal
Verify the conversation modal is no longer visible
Verify the main portal remains accessible

title: Switch the portal into high contrast mode
description: This test verifies that a user can toggle the interface into the alternate contrast theme for better readability.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle high contrast mode
Verify the alternate contrast theme is visible
Verify the main portal content remains visible

title: Close the Ask Eklavya chat assistant
description: A user can close the Ask Eklavya modal after opening it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Ask Eklavya chat assistant
Close the chat assistant
Verify the chat modal is dismissed

title: Increase and decrease text size on the portal
description: This test verifies that a user can adjust font scale using the accessibility controls and keep the portal usable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Increase text size using the accessibility controls
Decrease text size using the accessibility controls
Verify the text size changes are reflected in the interface
Verify the portal content remains readable and visible

title: Reject document consent and keep verification incomplete
description: This test verifies that a user can decline DigiLocker consent and remain on the verification step without fetched documents.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the DigiLocker services section
Fill in the security verification OTP with a valid six-digit code
Decline document access consent
Verify verified documents are not displayed
Verify the verification step remains available
